The Houthi rebels have launched an unconventional campaign against Saudi Arabia, one that involves neither missiles nor drones. Instead, they are leveraging the files of American sex offender and financier Jeffrey Epstein as a propaganda tool to damage Saudi Arabia's reputation. Through this campaign, the Houthis are positioning themselves as defenders of Islam against foreign powers. By using the Epstein scandal, they aim to undermine Saudi credibility while projecting themselves as protectors of the Islamic world.

recentItems.title: నవంబర్ 5 నుంచి ప్రపంచ తెలుగు బాలల పండుగ.. వీవీఐటీయూలో బాలోత్సవ్-2026!
recentItems.description:
The World Telugu Children's Festival, VVITU Balotsav 2026, is set to be held grandly from November 5 to 7 at the Vasireddy Venkatadri International Technological University campus, as announced by VVITU Chancellor Vasireddy Vidyasagar. The promotional materials for the event were jointly released by Vidyasagar, the college management, and students. According to Vidyasagar, Balotsav serves as an outstanding platform to bring out the hidden creativity in students while also helping to reduce their mental stress. The festival, which has been organized since 2017, has seen growing enthusiasm each year, and a large number of student participants are expected to attend this edition as well.
